note: The OTA the device took on 2026-09-07: app1 (flash 0x7F0000) of images/device/flash-2026-09-07-a.bin, booting (otadata entry 1 seq 2). Segments moved: DROM loads at 0x3c340020 (0x1d8f4c bytes, +184 KB), IROM at 0x42000020 with 0x33ad2c bytes (244 KB smaller than 7.2.4) at file 0x1e0020, so app file offset = VA - 0x41e20000 for IROM. Every site below was re-located from the 7.2.4 identity with tools/ghidra_stock.py --version 7.5.4 (session 8, docs/stock-7.5.4.md) and confirmed by a boot in the emulator with all three patches applied: Home, the 7-row nav menu (Read / Preload List / Statistics / All Files / USB / Cloud / Mini Apps) and the Mini Apps page listing an unsigned card app.

dev_stub.evidence: The 7.2.4 wrapper that reads the stub (entry / l32i a8,a2,84 / l32i a10,a8,176 / l32r / callx8 / s8i a10,a2,32 / retw.n, FUN_4213c6ac) exists in 7.5.4 as the 20-byte FUN_4214ab34 at file 0x32ab34 with the same shape (the presenter field moved 84 -> 88); its l32r literal is 0x4230dad4, a 7-byte compile-time stub (entry a1,32 / movi.n a2,0 / retw.n) with exactly that one caller in calls.txt, in the same stub cluster (0x4230bxxx-0x4230dxxx) that 7.2.4 keeps at 0x4233axxx. The wrapper's caller FUN_4214b2b4 (335 bytes) has the callee pattern of 7.2.4's light-panel opener FUN_4213ce68 (memcpy + the widget helpers).

developer-menu.description: developer mode: Memory / Developer / Screen Capture in the light panel
developer-menu.detail: movi.n a2,0 -> movi.n a2,1 in the developer-mode predicate stub (byte +4)
developer-menu.evidence: Same site as dev_stub. tools/appdis.py at 0x4230dad4 shows entry a1,32 / movi.n a2,0 / retw.n, the same instruction as 7.2.4's 0x4233abe0.

hidden-menu-rows.description: nav menu: unhide the Preload List and Statistics rows (gate A)
hidden-menu-rows.detail: bltui a9,2,+7 -> bltui a9,2,+255 in the menu-slot predicate at VA 0x42319508: slots 1 and 2 stop being skipped
hidden-menu-rows.evidence: The menu-slot predicate is the only 31-byte function in 7.5.4 IROM matching 7.2.4's 0x42345158 byte for byte except its last load (l8ui a2,a8,176 instead of 172): FUN_42319508 at file 0x4f9508, called from the nav-menu builder FUN_4214bce8, whose loop reads the slot -> page-id table 02 1c 16 09 0b 0a 0d 01 (DROM 0x3c3a6e80, unchanged from 7.2.4's 0x3c3dc8b0). The bltui a9,2,+7 (b6 29 07) sits at +0x12 = 0x4231951a. Emulator: the menu grows by Preload List and Statistics.

lua-apps-row.description: nav menu: a "Mini Apps" row that opens the Lua app list (page 0x09)
lua-apps-row.detail: l8ui a2,a8,176 -> movi a2,1 in the menu-slot predicate: slot 3 is always shown
lua-apps-row.evidence: 7.5.4's builder FUN_4214bce8 no longer skips slot 3 and appends it behind presenter+172: it walks all eight slots through the order table 00 01 02 04 05 06 03 07 (DROM 0x3c3a6e78) and the predicate alone gates slot 3 with the byte at presenter+176 (l8ui a2,a8,176 at 0x42319522, the same flag 7.2.4 tested at +172 in FUN_4213d834 and which nothing writes). The 7.2.4 site (l8ui a8,a2,172 in the builder) has no counterpart, so the equivalent edit is this load. Emulator: a "Mini Apps" row (label group 12, 7.2.4's "Lua Apps" renamed) between Cloud and Settings, entering the app list page, which lists the unsigned hello app from the card.

counts.evidence: Found by scanning DROM for the header shape (u16 groups, u16 4, lang ids 00 01 02 03, u16 blob_size) and validating every offset; header at file 0xa6de0, blob 689 bytes at 0x3c3e6e7a ending at 0x3c3e712b, one byte before the label pack's header -- identical content to 7.2.4.

labels.evidence: Same scan: header at file 0xa712c, 269 groups x 4 languages, blob 16,248 bytes at 0x3c3e799e ending at 0x3c3eb916; two alignment zeros follow and the DROM bitmap directory (30 00 00 00 2c 00 00 00 ...) starts at 0x3c3eb918, so the stock free tail is 2 bytes as in 7.2.4. 7.5.4 inserted three groups at 5-7 and more later, so every label id from 5 up moved (difflib alignment: 225 of the 234 old groups map 1:1; see known_groups and docs/stock-7.5.4.md).

toasts_not_loadable.why: The headerless toast pack changed format in 7.5.4: its offset table is u32 per slot (the blob outgrew the u16 ceiling), which stockstrings.py's u16 PackSpec cannot describe, so no `packs.toasts` entry is given -- a u16 parse of this table would be wrong, not merely refused. Numbers for a future u32-aware reader:
toasts_not_loadable.evidence: The 7.2.4 blob head (NUL, 取消, Cancel, キャンセル, 国内 / Domestic ...) is at DROM 0x3c4831b0 (file 0x1431b0); walking back in 16-byte steps while all four u32 words are 0 or point at a string start gives 874 groups starting at 0x3c47fb10 (preceded by a table of IROM function pointers); the highest offset is 0x11919 and the last string ends at 0x3c494b10, where the ordinary string table's user_config begins. Group 0 = Cancel, 3 = 'Region set successfully', 873 = 'TF card unavailable; cannot export the report'. 2,813 distinct strings in 3,496 slots.

label_group_moves.what: 7.2.4 label id -> 7.5.4 label id for the groups stockstrings.py names (difflib alignment of the 4-language tuples); 'Lua Apps' 9 -> 12 'Mini Apps', 'USB Mode' 11 -> 14 'USB', 'Cloud Sync' 137 -> 152 'Cloud', 'About Device' 169 -> 185 'Device information' are renames at the aligned position
